name: agentkit
description: A coordination layer for multi-agent work: one coordinator, role profiles with per-role model pinning, deterministic zero-token checkpoints, launch preflight, and memory that stays with the coordinator instead of following every disposable worker.

orca_supervision.title: Supervised Orca workers
orca_supervision.description: Run 2b work as supervised Orca workers so a human can watch and steer each one. Turn this off to fall back to in-session subagents, which are invisible in the agent window and must be declared in the handoff.

memory_isolation.title: Keep memory with the coordinator
memory_isolation.description: Launch disposable workers against a plugin-free config directory so a cross-session memory store records the coordinator's work and not every throwaway probe.

auto_trust.title: Record folder trust automatically
auto_trust.description: Answer each CLI's folder-trust question once, on the record, when preflight runs in a project. Without it an unattended pane stops on the prompt and looks hung.

permission_tier.title: Worker permission tier
permission_tier.description: auto = permissive but answerable (--permission-mode auto, -a on-request, --mode accept-edits). strict = leave every check in place and expect prompts.

graph_integration.title: graphify code graph
graph_integration.description: Route structure questions to graphify and attach a scoped subgraph to each dispatch. The coordinator holds the query monopoly; workers never grep for structure.

vault_integration.title: Obsidian vault
vault_integration.description: Enable the vault as the store of accepted decisions, with scribe as its only writer, an evidence gate in place of human approval, and the wikilink scanner as its check.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Leave empty to discover the directory containing .obsidian under the project root.

checkpoint_hooks.title: Automatic checkpoints
checkpoint_hooks.description: Write mechanical state to .orchestrator/journal.md on Stop, SessionEnd, and SessionStart. Runs without a model, so a session that dies abruptly costs one unit of work rather than the whole session.

council_enabled.title: Council protocol
council_enabled.description: Two vendors cross-reading one evidence pack. Runs only when a human asks; never on the coordinator's own initiative.
